description: Ministry of Youth and Sports - Sports Law No. 25 of 1973
categorisation: This gazette contains regulations made by the Minister of Sports under the Sports Law No. 25 of 1973, specifically amending procedures for appointing Selection Committees of National Sports Associations. The content focuses on legal/regulatory matters - creating new regulations, repealing previous sections, and establishing legal procedures for sports governance. While it mentions Minister Namal Rajapaksa, it does not include detailed portfolio responsibilities about his ministerial duties, making this primarily a legal/regulatory document rather than a government personnel or hybrid gazette.
